title: The Fox and the Crow · complete fable
instructions: 真人历史作品朗读，非现代场景对话或官方试卷。先独立听音并完成6题，再提交核对；录制署名不出题。级别只是编写目标，未做真实考生难度标定。来源与署名可在开始后查看；若打开外部全文或原音，后续继续按已见材料记录。
transcript: A Crow was sitting on a branch of a tree with a piece of cheese in her beak when a Fox observed her and set his wits to work to discover some way of getting the cheese. Coming and standing under the tree he looked up and said, "What a noble bird I see above me! Her beauty is without equal, the hue of her plumage exquisite. If only her voice is as sweet as her looks are fair, she ought without doubt to be Queen of the Birds." The Crow was hugely flattered by this, and just to show the Fox that she could sing she gave a loud caw. Down came the cheese, of course, and the Fox, snatching it up, said, "You have a voice, madam, I see: what you want is wits."

questions.prompt: Where was the Crow when the Fox first saw her?
questions.evidence: A Crow was sitting on a branch of a tree
questions.explanation: 开头直接交代地点；under the tree 是狐狸的位置。

questions.prompt: What food was the Crow holding? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: with a piece of cheese in her beak
questions.explanation: 食物是 cheese；beak 是含住它的部位。

questions.prompt: What was the Fox trying to achieve?
questions.evidence: set his wits to work to discover some way of getting the cheese.
questions.explanation: 狐狸设计奉承话的目的是得到食物。

questions.prompt: Which two qualities did the Fox connect in his praise?
questions.evidence: If only her voice is as sweet as her looks are fair
questions.explanation: voice 与 looks 是奉承中联系起来的两种特征。

questions.prompt: Why did the Crow make a sound?
options: To ask the Fox for help
To prove that she could sing
answers: To prove that she could sing
questions.evidence: just to show the Fox that she could sing she gave a loud caw.
questions.explanation: show ... could sing 是发声目的，未提到其他鸟或求助。

questions.prompt: What happened immediately after the Crow called?
questions.evidence: Down came the cheese, of course
questions.explanation: 叫声使嘴里的食物掉下；狐狸无需爬树。
